description: 1 free call per caller, then $0.0075 USDC via x402 (paid in-band: params._meta["x402/payment"]). Company enrichment: domain in, company profile out - name, description, language, logo, founding date, address (schema.org), official social profiles, key pages (contact, about, careers, pricing) and email provider (MX). Only the company's own website and DNS; robots.txt respected; no personal data. When to use: Use company-profile to enrich a domain; company-techstack for technologies; company-contacts for business contact details; company-batch for up to 10 domains.
